items.title: Hopes Fade for Senate Crypto Bill Vote, Leaving Coinbase Stock Exposed
items.summary: Earlier this summer, it seemed that a major crypto bill would likely become law this year.  The bill has been a major goal of  Coinbase  Global and other cryptocurrency firms, which have spent years lobbying and making campaign contributions to pro-crypto lawmakers just to get to this point.  The Senate is scheduled to begin a long recess this week, and crypto advocates had hoped that it would pass the bill before departing.
